patch_list: 120 refresh rate

Lifts the 60 Hz limit Maps puts on itself, on the app and on the map, so it can run at your screen's full refresh rate (such as 120 Hz). Uses more battery, most of all while navigating. Off by default: switch it on on the Customization scr…
Account sheet cleanup
Removes the "More from this app" label from the account sheet, and keeps the sheet open when you come back from Settings or Customization or tap "Your profile", instead of dropping back to the map.
Add microG-RE support
Builds microG Maps, a separate app that signs in to your Google account through microG-RE (MicroG-RE or ReVanced GmsCore). Not for root installs; for original microG, use Add original microG support.
Add original microG support
Signs in through original microG on ROMs with signature spoofing. Keeps Maps' own package name; allow signature spoofing for it.
Any media app

Navigation's Default media app (Settings > Navigation) offers every music and podcast app that works with Android Auto, such as Poweramp, also where Google switches media controls off. YouTube Music and Spotify only connect to Google's own…
Avoid Flock cameras

Steers driving directions around Flock cameras: when Google's route passes one, a camera-free way is worked out with BRouter, an OpenStreetMap router, and Maps asks Google again for a route through it, so Google still times and navigates t…
Better offline maps

Reworks the offline area picker: zooming out really selects more instead of being shrunk to Google's size cap, the box can be resized by dragging its edges and corners, a large area is split into several downloads whose true total size is…
Black theme
AMOLED-black theme. Pins Maps' own dark mode and its separate navigation colour scheme, and remaps colour resources, drawable fills and draw-time paints so no surface is left grey.
Blue pin
Chromium-coloured flat map pin on every in-app product logo and the search bar's leading icon.
Bypass Play Services checks

Makes Maps' bundled Play services signature and availability checks always pass, so it runs re-signed and with Play services disabled or absent, and lets it load tiles, search and routing by sending Google's own package and certificate in…
Change app name
Sets the launcher and in-app app name.
Change package name
Installs alongside stock Google Maps under its own package name. On by default, because stock Maps comes built into most phones and cannot be replaced by a patched copy.
Customization screen
Adds a Customization row under Settings on the account sheet, with switches for the patches here that can be turned back off inside the app.
Flock cameras

Puts Flock and other license plate reader cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap -- the cameras DeFlock's volunteers map -- and chimes and shows a note when one is coming up ahead. Off until turned on in Waze & external data source, a row…
Hide ads and clutter

Hides promoted map pins (on the map, in search results and along a route) and "Sponsored" search results, Gemini's AI summaries ("Know before you go" and the review summary), the row of businesses under an address on its place sheet, the h…
Legacy icon
Uses the flat multicolour pin Maps had before the 2025 gradient icon as the launcher icon and on the screen Maps opens with. With Add microG-RE support, microG's C sits in the pin's circle.
Location provider toggle

Adds a Location source choice to the Customization screen: Android's own location providers, microG-RE's or Google Play services' fused provider. With Android, neither is ever asked for a location. A source that is missing or disabled is n…
Offline saved places

Save places without a Google account, kept only on the phone: Save opens Maps' own "Place saved" sheet (Want to go, Travel plans, Starred places, Favorites, your own lists, a note), and a "Local saved" row on the account sheet rebuilds Map…
Power saving mode

Brings the Pixel-only power saving mode to every phone: while driving with navigation, press the power button and Maps shows only key information such as the next turn on a black screen. Turn it on or off in Settings > Navigation > Power s…
Proxy

Adds a Proxy screen to Customization that sends Maps' own traffic, map data included, through an HTTP proxy -- for example Orbot's (127.0.0.1:8118) to use Tor. Map data never falls back to a direct connection: if the proxy stops, Maps stop…
Rectangle shapes
Squares off rounded corners across the UI, including the two round navigation buttons.
Remove permissions

Removes permissions that only serve Google-account features or Google's data collection: background location, physical activity, contacts, microphone (voice search stops working), camera (Lens and Live View stop working), car speed, advert…
Remove sign-in prompts

Removes Google's sign-in prompts: the first-launch "Make it your map" page, the search screen's "Tired of typing?" card and the account sheet's "Sign in" pill. Tapping "Your profile" (or the pill, where it still shows) answers with a "Can'…
Remove telemetry

Points the Firebase Installations and Play services compliance check-ins at an unresolvable host, stops every ad impression and click ping from being sent, and deregisters Google's logging, performance-monitoring, survey and Location Histo…
Speed cameras

Chimes and shows a note when a speed or red light camera is coming up ahead, and puts the cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap. Off until turned on in Waze & external data source, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the came…
Speeding chime

Plays a chime when your speed passes the speed limit during navigation, as Waze does. Maps itself only turns its speedometer red. When it chimes is chosen in Waze & external data source, a row on the account sheet.
Trim account menu
Removes Your Timeline, Location sharing, Your data in Maps and Help & feedback from the account sheet. Left out with Add microG-RE support, whose account features need them.
Waze alerts

Shows the alerts a Waze on the same phone is tracking -- police to begin with, and any of crashes, hazards, traffic jams, closures and speed cameras -- as pins on the map, with a chime and a note as one comes up ahead. Off until turned on…
Zoom controls in navigation
Adds +, − and reset tiles during turn-by-turn that change the navigation zoom while the camera keeps following the car.

patch_list: BYD native battery experiment

Google Maps for MicroG-RE

Picture-in-picture setting

Adds a Picture-in-picture On/Off setting to Maps Settings. Turn it off so navigation does not open a small window when you leave Maps; it starts on, as in Maps. Hooks inspected on Maps 26.41 and 26.42.
